title: C.46:8-18.1 Residential rental property application fee not to exceed $50
requirement: A landlord or their agent may not charge an application or similar fee to lease or sublease a residential rental property that exceeds $50, subject to annual CPI adjustments.
exemptions: one-family or two-family dwellings; licensees of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission who are not the landlord
quoted_span: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
